name: Option 4 — Leadership (Moderation Guide)
reference_usage: Visual language shared with /research-plan Option 4; the runtime does not require access to any private reference document. page/colors/typography/warning/spacing tokens are copied verbatim from the research-plan contract so the finished look matches. The document structure is inferred generically (structure-agnostic) and each table's geometry is derived from its complete header.
supported_guide_shapes: Interview / IDI (# Moderation Guide plus study-title top matter, RACI, Parameter and Consent tables, prose-bullet themes with indented probes, optional Parking Lot)
Prototype / Usability (# Moderation Guide plus study-title top matter, RACI, Parameter and Session Flow tables, bold-label read/do lists, optional vendor Communication & Deliverables back-matter)

breadcrumb._note: Retained for backward-compatible parsing only. The canonical schema starts with # Moderation Guide and has no breadcrumb or kicker.

phase_subtitle._note: Styles the required ## Study Title top-matter line (dark-green-on-white, distinct from white-on-green section bands).

heading._note: Inherited research-plan token; intentionally UNUSED in mod-guide. Its structural role is taken by the 14pt section bands.

section_band._note: Applied to every section Heading-2 after the required Study Title top-matter line.

sub_phase_heading._note: Applied to EVERY Heading-3 (e.g. 'Flow 1', '2.1'); green-on-white so it never reads as a band. Alt: DM Sans 11pt bold #003D29.

context_note._note: Used for the optional 'Last updated' metadata line.

structure.role_inference: canonical — first H1 must be 'Moderation Guide'; the immediately following H2 is the Study Title top-matter line; RACI = consecutive '**Label:** …' bullets; warning = the TEST ARTIFACT paragraph; every later H2 = band; every H3 = sub-phase; every table = Option 4 table styling; every list preserves nesting; all other paragraphs = body.
structure.no_terminal_section: The guide may end anywhere (a table may appear after Post-Session Debrief). The formatter does NOT enforce a terminal section — that content rule lives in SKILL.md / the templates.

section_bands.applies_to: every section ## heading after the required Study Title top-matter line; labels adapt to the study, do not copy an old study's wording

tables.border: Google Docs default; the pipeline sends NO border request (mirrors research-plan's Option 4 pipeline). Settled 2026-10-02 after two live builds verified clean with default borders — do not invent a border value.
tables.column_width_rule: Derive widths from the complete header. Phase|Time uses [554.4, 144] so the agenda phase stays wide. A first header cell of '#' uses [90, remaining]. Other two-column label/content tables such as Parameter|Detail and Cue|Read aloud use [144, 554.4]. For 3+ columns, reserve 144pt for the first label column and split the remainder evenly.
tables.label_background_rule: The two-column Parameter|Detail dashboard in top matter gets the gray label column. In-section Consent and Session Flow tables use white body cells.
tables.first_column_bold_rule: The first column renders bold when every first cell in the source Markdown is fully bold, as in Parameter|Detail and Cue|Read aloud. Session Flow phases remain normal weight unless the approved Markdown explicitly emphasizes them.

optional_header_row.note: The Markdown header row is treated as a conversion header and dropped on import (the first content row becomes the first visible row). Header presence is detected per table by row count, so a table may or may not arrive with the header still attached.
